verdict.rationale: Evidence shows employee-facing vesting alerts (pulley-docs-37) and a stakeholder profile view (pulley-docs-4), plus 'interactive offer letters' (pulley-docs-38), suggesting some employee-facing equity info exists, but there is no documentation of a dedicated employee portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price, and equity value under different outcome scenarios. Missing for 10: dedicated employee self-service portal UI, strike price display to employees, and equity outcome/valuation scenario modeling accessible to employees.
